# Context Kit
> Guides for making AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok) remember who you are using one personal context file.

## Guides
- [Home](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/): what a context file is and the universal paste method
- [ChatGPT](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/chatgpt.html): Custom Instructions, Memory, Projects
- [Claude](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/claude.html): Instructions for Claude, Projects, Memory
- [Gemini](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/gemini.html): Instructions for Gemini, Gems and skills
- [Grok](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/grok.html): custom instructions (steps unverified)
- [FAQ](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/faq.html)
- [Why ChatGPT isn't remembering you](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/chatgpt-not-remembering.html): memory settings, temporary chat, projects
- [Claude Projects](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/claude-projects.html): project instructions, knowledge base, per-project memory
- [Does Gemini remember past chats?](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/gemini-remember-past-chats.html): Memory setting, requirements, correcting and deleting
- [Does Claude remember past conversations?](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/claude-remember-past-chats.html): memory vs chat search, plans, editing and deleting memory, incognito
- [Does Grok remember past conversations?](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/grok-remember-past-chats.html): Grok memory, forgetting a memory, Private Chat, deleting history
- [How ChatGPT Projects work](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/chatgpt-projects.html): project instructions, files, default vs project-only memory, limits by plan
- [Are custom GPTs going away?](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/chatgpt-custom-gpts-retiring.html): Dec 11, 2026 retirement, migrating to plugins, what transfers, keeping your instructions
- [Are Gemini Gems going away?](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/gemini-gems-to-skills.html): Gems to skills transition dates, what carries over, files that don't, moving a Gem yourself
- [What happened to Claude Styles?](https://steadiwork.github.io/aicontextkit/claude-styles-to-skills.html): custom styles migrating to skills, slash commands, the Learning skill, using Instructions for Claude instead
